The '''Battle of Fleyars IV''' took place on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fleyars IV]], where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] managed to subjugate the planet.<ref name="CSWE" /> The hero of the battle was [[Akal Zed]], who took over command of the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Seswennan Nightcloak]]'' when its [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]].
